composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Create an original thirty-one-year-old adult wearing an ocher structured vest over a dark turtleneck. Build the vest from three broad angular paper planes, leaving the face softer and rounder. A short side-part haircut and small neutral smile give the portrait character. Keep the neckline high and the body fully dressed. The pale rose background holds one darker cut-paper shadow, with visible paper thickness only at the garment edges. Use paper-cut fashion collage. Square 1024x1024 avatar; keep the central subject clear, with no text, logo, watermark, or circular border.
